rootCause.summary: V5 creates the cache, applies chmod -R a-w to the source cache, copies it with cp -a into negative_cache (preserving non-writable directory modes), then the failing rm -rf runs in the GitHub Actions host runner shell. In the local reproducer that actor is the host UID 501; the selected entry is present but cannot be unlinked because its copied parent directory lacks write permission.

actorAttribution.v5Actor: GitHub Actions host runner shell, before docker load/create and before --user 65532:65532 is applied

claimBoundary: G0 local filesystem reproducer confirms the host-side V5 negative-cache deletion root cause. It does not claim UID 65532 container execution, Docker runtime containment, corrected workflow behavior, cache readiness, smoke pass, or Sol acceptance.
